verdict.rationale: Skills exist so users can hand tasks to Claude, the built-in assistant. Claude loads a skill when it judges it relevant, or the user invokes one directly with `/skill-name` (docs-2, docs-25). Bundled skills like `/run` and `/verify` work without setup (docs-5), and skill-creator has Claude author and improve skills itself (docs-13). Hands-on community reports say automatic invocation is hit-or-miss, and Vercel's evals found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases, so users often must trigger skills explicitly (comm-12, comm-13, comm-14). missing for 10: reliable automatic delegation without explicit invocation, independent corroboration of end-to-end task delegation quality.
